I'll be in Paris on the 15th of November and I'm craving some Israeli cuisine. Can you help me find a restaurant with great ratings and reviews?
            Also, could you please add an event to my calendar for the 14th of November to remind me to book a table? The event title should be 'Dinner at {restaurant_name}', and the location set to the restaurant's address.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
paris_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get cuisine types for all restaurants to find Israeli cuisine
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(paris_restaurants)

# Use AI assistant to identify restaurants with Israeli cuisine
class RestaurantInfo(BaseModel):
    name: str
    cuisine: str

israeli_restaurants_query = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following list of restaurants and their cuisine types, identify which ones serve Israeli cuisine:\n{cuisine_types}",
    list[RestaurantInfo]
)

# Filter for Israeli cuisine
israeli_restaurant_names = [r.name for r in israeli_restaurants_query if r.cuisine.lower() == "israeli"]

if not israeli_restaurant_names:
    raise ValueError("No Israeli restaurants found in Paris.")

# Get ratings and reviews for Israeli restaurants
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(israeli_restaurant_names)

# Use AI assistant to find the best rated restaurant
class BestRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float
    review_summary: str

best_restaurant_query = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Based on the following ratings and reviews, identify the restaurant with the best ratings and reviews:\n{ratings_reviews}",
    BestRestaurant
)

best_restaurant_name = best_restaurant_query.name

# Get the address of the best restaurant
restaurant_address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_name])

# Extract the address from the dictionary
address_value = restaurant_address.get(best_restaurant_name, "Address not available")

# Create calendar event for November 14th
event_title = f"Dinner at {best_restaurant_name}"
event_description = f"Reminder to book a table at {best_restaurant_name} for dinner."
start_time = "2024-11-14 18:00"
end_time = "2024-11-14 18:30"

create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description=event_description,
    participants=None,
    location=address_value
)
```
